name: Eternal Pain: Epiphany
source:
Mental pain will never disappear, it will forever torment the soul of the protagonist. Who is he? How did he end up here? Why do dead people appear before him? Who is this girl with bandaged eyes? Eternal Pain: Epiphany is the story of the insight of a person who finds himself in purgatory.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350060/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
精神上的痛苦永远不会消失，将永远折磨主人公的灵魂。他是谁？为何会来到这里？死者为什么会出现在他面前？那个双眼缠着绷带的女孩又是谁？《Eternal Pain: Epiphany》讲述了一个身处炼狱之人逐渐醒悟的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350060/]Steam[/url]]
